content: Official R3F 'Performance pitfalls' doc (r3f.docs.pmnd.rs/advanced/pitfalls) is authoritative: (1) Three.js mutations belong in useFrame with refs, not React state -- calling setState 60x/sec tanks frame rate within seconds; (2) use frame delta (position.x += delta) not fixed increments so speed is framerate-independent; (3) with frameloop='demand' rendering only happens on interaction/explicit invalidate, useful for a mostly-static cell scene, but continuous toolpath playback needs continuous render so default frameloop is correct during playback; (4) object creation (materials/geometries/lights) is expensive -- avoid mounting/unmounting Three.js objects every render, memoize with useMemo and reuse.
